simple.meaning: angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant.
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַבִּיר (H47) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 17 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַבִּיר (ʼabbîyr) means angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant. First listed occurrence: 1Sam 21 8.

definitions.full: H47. abbir אַבִּיר adjective mighty, valiant — ׳א Job 34:20 + Isa 10:13 Kt (Qr כַּבִּיר ); construct id. 1Sam 21:8 ; plural אַכִּירִים Job 24:22 +; — mighty (always = substantive & in poetry except 1Sam 21:8 ). 1 men Job 24:22 (= violent ) 34:20 ; 1Sam 21:8 (read ׳א הָרָצִים Gr Dr, compare 22:17 ; but Lag Probebibel הָעֲיָרִים אֹבִיל see Id. BN 45 ; Klo גִּבּוֺר ), Lam 1:15 ; לֵב אַבִּירֵי stout of heart Isa 46:12 (= obstinate ) Psa 76:6 . 2 angels Psalm Psa 78:25 (compare 103:20 ). 3 animals ; bull, simile of king of Assyrian Isa 10:13 (read כְּאַבִּיר & see Di); elsewhere plural; metaphor for enemies בָשָׁן אַבִּירֵי ) Psa 22:13 (|| מּרים ); for princes 68:31 ; for Edomites Isa 34:7 ; hence even as sacrificial Psa 50:13 (|| עַתּוּדִים ); of horses Jer 8:16 ; 47:3 ; 50:11 . ** Judg 5:22 ; Jer 46:15 (but 46:15 many MSS. ᵐ5 Aq Symm Theod ᵑ9 many moderns read אַבִּירֶ֑ךָ thy bull , i.e. Apis). אַבְרָהָם see אַבְרָם below II. אבה .
